secondary_root_causes: Dataset query-channel artifact (oracle syllables + ASR char conflict)
recommended_next_phase: Phase 7C — Stage A representation/objective fix candidates (phonetic-inductive bias, hard-negative mining, early-stop policy) as CAUSAL probes — do not silently replace baseline.
primary_mechanism: Stage A query fuses conflicting ASR char evidence with oracle syllables; training minimizes pool CE largely via SEEN-term candidate lexical geometry; UNSEEN terms lose that geometry and the model does not fall back to syllable-identity matching.

dataset_construction.implication: Phonetic/Fuzzy baselines are near-oracle on syllable identity; Case A still shows Stage A fails to exploit this transferable signal and instead memorizes SEEN candidate/query patterns.
